blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine National Police (PNP) asserted that the two youths caught vandalizing in the City of Manila during a rally to mark the 54th anniversary of the declaration of martial law were not arrested but only pacified. On Monday morning, tensions rose between rallyists and police officers along C.M. Recto Avenue after the two individuals were approached by police officers supposedly due to vandalism. “They were just pacified,” PNP spokesperson PCol. Allen Rae Co said in a briefing on Monday afternoon when asked about the incident. “They were restrained from doing anything else, but they were not actually […]...
